packageRules.description: policy: Skip routine patch updates for language packages; keep minor, major, runtime, app, and security updates
Group identical packages across all files

Keep golang Dockerfile updates disabled because annotated ARGs manage Go image tags separately from Go toolchain versions, and the Dockerfile manager also expands ARG-backed FROM images; source: https://github.com/spigell/my-images/pull/383; review after: 2026-12-07

Keep the Pulumi CLI, workbench image and core SDKs (Go, npm, Python) on the manually approved version 3.267.0, already merged in pulumi-talos-cluster; source: https://github.com/spigell/pulumi-talos-cluster/pull/63; review after: 2026-11-02

my-cloud-identity, my-reforge-ai, and my-reforge-tasks lint with typescript-eslint, which supports only TypeScript below 6.1 and crashes on TypeScript 7; source: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940, https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/pull/12803, https://github.com/spigell/my-reforge-tasks/pull/140; review after: 2026-11-06
